notes: Ask for a voice note in plain words: say \u201creply with a voice note: \u2026\u201d or \u201csay that out loud\u201d and momo sends a real audio bubble \u2014 using the Mac's own voice when cloud text-to-speech isn't set up. The /voice on toggle still speaks every answer automatically.
notes_zh: 一句话就能要一条语音：说\u201c用语音回复：……\u201d或\u201c大声读出来\u201d，momo 就会发出真正的语音气泡——没配置云端语音时用 Mac 自带的嗓音。/voice on 开关依然会自动把每条回答读出来。
